purpose: Formal downstream benchmark to test whether crop-specific genome pretraining improves crop genomic tasks under identical splits, heads, metrics, and tuning budgets.
plain_purpose_cn: 正式检验作物专用基因组预训练模型是否在作物任务上优于通用 DNA 大模型，而不是只看训练 loss 或内部 probe。

checkpoint_policy.checkpoint_selection: select on validation split only; final test is one-time after task/head/model choices are frozen
checkpoint_policy.online_probe_policy: online/full-region probes are health checks only and cannot be used as paper-facing wins

fair_comparison_rules: same train/valid/test split for all models
same input window length per task, with 512bp/1kb/2kb/8kb length-controlled panels where useful
same downstream head family and tuning budget for all frozen-embedding comparisons
same fine-tuning epoch/step budget and early-stopping rule for full fine-tuning comparisons
report mean +/- std over 5 seeds for headline tasks
never compare our custom probe directly to literature metrics from different tasks; literature numbers are scale references only
all normalization, sampling, and negative construction must be fit from train split only

ours: CropGenome-FM-v2-Stable-8K full fine-tuning where GPU budget allows
public_dna_models: Nucleotide Transformer v2 / NT models available locally or via HuggingFace
AgroNT or other plant DNA model if weights are accessible
classical_baselines: GC/length-matched heuristic baseline where biologically relevant

cross_crop_panels: soybean/legume held-out transfer where labels exist

task_groups.question_cn: 模型是否真正学到作物基因结构语法？

tasks.title_cn: 剪接供体/受体硬负样本识别
tasks.positive_definition: annotated donor/acceptor junction-centered windows from high-confidence transcripts
tasks.negative_definition: GT/AG motif-containing non-junction windows matched by GC, length, contig, and distance-to-gene
tasks.success_threshold: CropGenome-FM beats best public DNA model and CNN by >=3% relative AUPRC on species_holdout or low_homology_holdout
tasks.plain_explanation_cn: 不能只靠 GT/AG 两个碱基取巧；负样本也含 GT/AG，逼模型学习上下文。

tasks.title_cn: 外显子/内含子/UTR 序列标注
tasks.positive_definition: token-level labels for exon, intron, 5UTR, 3UTR, intergenic from independent GFF/GTF-derived evaluation set
tasks.success_threshold: higher macro_F1 and boundary_F1 than public DNA embeddings under same head
tasks.plain_explanation_cn: 看模型能否按碱基位置画出基因结构边界。

tasks.title_cn: 翻译起始/终止位点上下文识别
tasks.negative_definition: same-codon or same-frame decoy windows from coding regions
tasks.success_threshold: beats k-mer and public DNA models under gene_family_holdout
tasks.plain_explanation_cn: 检查模型是否学到编码区起止语法，而不是只看 ATG/TAA/TAG/TGA。

task_groups.question_cn: 作物专用预训练是否更擅长作物调控元件？

tasks.positive_definition: TSS-centered promoter windows from annotated genes, optionally stratified by tissue expression evidence when available
tasks.negative_definition: GC/length/accessibility-matched intergenic windows and promoter-shift decoys
tasks.success_threshold: >=3% relative AUPRC over best public model in species_holdout; larger gains expected in few-shot panels
tasks.plain_explanation_cn: 看模型是否识别作物启动子序列，而不是只利用 GC 含量。

tasks.title_cn: TES/polyA 转录终止信号识别
tasks.negative_definition: matched downstream decoy windows and AT-rich non-boundary windows
tasks.success_threshold: beats CNN/k-mer/public DNA models on assembly_holdout and species_holdout
tasks.plain_explanation_cn: 终止信号更弱，若能提升说明模型学到非编码上下文。

tasks.title_cn: ATAC 开放染色质峰预测（有数据物种）
tasks.positive_definition: processed ATAC/ACR peaks mapped to sequence windows after assembly compatibility QC
tasks.negative_definition: GC/mappability/length-matched non-peak windows from same chromosomes
tasks.success_threshold: crop pretrained model shows stronger few-shot and cross-crop retention than generic DNA models
tasks.plain_explanation_cn: ATAC 表示染色质开放区域；这是调控潜力，不是表达本身。

tasks.title_cn: 组织/逆境响应启动子活性预测
tasks.positive_definition: promoters linked to tissue-specific or stress-responsive expression bins from processed expression matrices
tasks.negative_definition: fold-aware expression-bin negatives and matched non-responsive promoters
tasks.success_threshold: improves most in low-label panels; report fold-aware expression baselines
tasks.plain_explanation_cn: 把序列和表达证据连接起来，检验调控功能。

task_groups.question_cn: 模型是否捕捉作物基因组结构特色？

tasks.title_cn: 高置信 EDTA 转座元件边界识别
tasks.positive_definition: EDTA high-confidence TE insertion boundaries with family labels
tasks.negative_definition: TE interior windows and matched non-repeat windows
tasks.success_threshold: run only after EDTA QC passes; compare by TE family and species holdout
tasks.plain_explanation_cn: 转座元件是作物大基因组的重要结构特征，但标签质量必须先过关。

tasks.title_cn: 长上下文基因边界识别
tasks.positive_definition: gene start/end and flanking regions across 8kb/64kb/128kb panels
tasks.negative_definition: near-gene decoy boundaries and intergenic segments
tasks.success_threshold: longer context checkpoints outperform 512bp/1kb truncated inputs
tasks.plain_explanation_cn: 用来证明长上下文不是摆设。

task_groups.question_cn: 模型能否帮助解释作物变异和育种候选区域？

tasks.positive_definition: processed trait-associated SNP/indel or eQTL/QTL-linked variants from published tables only
tasks.negative_definition: matched nearby non-associated variants; no raw WGS/FASTQ/BAM re-calling
tasks.success_threshold: higher top-k enrichment than k-mer, conservation/proximity heuristics, and public DNA models
tasks.plain_explanation_cn: 比较 ref/alt 两个等位序列的模型分数变化，用于排序可能有功能影响的变异。

tasks.title_cn: QTL/GWAS 区间候选基因排序
tasks.positive_definition: known candidate genes or high-confidence curated genes inside crop QTL/GWAS intervals
tasks.negative_definition: other genes in same interval with matched length/expression availability
tasks.success_threshold: improves candidate-gene enrichment over distance-to-peak and gene-length/expression baselines
tasks.plain_explanation_cn: 更贴近育种应用：在一个关联区间里把候选基因排到前面。

task_groups.question_cn: 作物专用预训练的优势是否体现在跨作物和低样本场景？

tasks.positive_definition: repeat core tasks with one crop species/genus held out
tasks.success_threshold: higher retention_ratio than public DNA models; this is the main proof of crop-specific pretraining
tasks.plain_explanation_cn: 训练没见过某个作物，测试时还能不能迁移过去。

tasks.positive_definition: subsample labeled training data while keeping validation/test fixed
tasks.success_threshold: CropGenome-FM has larger gain over public models at 1%-10% labels than at full labels
tasks.plain_explanation_cn: 基础模型最应该在标注少时有优势。

minimum_for_main_claim: at least three P0 tasks completed with fixed test artifacts
CropGenome-FM beats the strongest available public DNA model on average by >=3% relative on crop-specific held-out tests
improvement is present in at least one species_holdout or genus_holdout panel
5-seed mean +/- std is reported for headline tasks
no-region, no-pretrain, CNN, k-mer, random/majority baselines are included
custom probes are labeled diagnostic only
strong_claim_target: >=5% relative mean improvement over strongest public model across P0 crop tasks
larger gains under few-shot or cross-crop transfer than in random assembly holdout
variant/QTL ranking shows top-k enrichment beyond sequence-composition and distance heuristics
